assertions.target_title: Rayon From Bamboo 1800TC Luxury Sheet Sets

notes: During the full sync, the live API reported 8586 deals, but the BestSelling offset scan returned 8577 rows containing only 8552 unique deal IDs.

A later 1000-row live search sample reported a then-current total of 8548 and returned a complete requested window with 1000 unique IDs; the differing totals show that the catalog changed between invocations.
Because Woot did not provide a complete stable enumeration, the CLI skipped pruning, retained cursor 0, and exited with an explicit incomplete-snapshot warning.
Local search remained useful and surfaced prices, while its JSON provenance correctly warned that missing matches were not authoritative.
No API key or other credential value is stored in this proof.
